purpose: Prospectively specified primary and sensitivity comparisons; never pool with development or historical fits
fitting_dependency: Public transposed-bock-aitkin-em 1.4.0rc1 normalized map; WILD-style baseline adapters. This is a separate prospective execution, not a continuation of prior results.
fitted_populations: Normal only; 1PL and 2PL; TBAEM-D, TBAEM-C when applicable, torch_measure JML, py-irt VI
identification: Generate N(0,1) capabilities; center realized log discrimination before generating responses. Export theta and b on the mean-b-zero, mean-log-a-zero realized-item scale, preserving probabilities.
sensitivity_targets: Individual generating parameters and predictive risk. Under contaminated-normal misspecification, population differences from known generating moments are descriptive discrepancies, not bias about a proven likelihood target. Clustered items retain the normal marginal population; cross-item independence fails.
primary_contrasts: TBAEM-C minus TBAEM-D theta RMSE in nonzero-correlation cells
Each TBAEM specification minus JML and VI theta RMSE
Each TBAEM specification minus JML and VI held-out log loss
mcse_unit: independent replication, never individual parameter or held-out response
failure_policy: 2000 assigned attempts per condition; preserve all failures, limits, and interrupted attempts; never replace seeds or rerun a recorded attempt
smoke_policy: Disjoint seeds and output tree; six small matrices with full fitting settings plus all 24 full-size generators. No smoke fit contributes to production. Runtime at the largest sizes is not established by the small smoke test.

execution.workers: launch.py run --workers N (default 1), one single-threaded process per matrix, pinned to its own core on Linux, at most one per physical core; each session is recorded in execution_log.jsonl

inference: No parameter standard errors or coverage claims. Existing WILD predictive bootstrap and application fits are not rerun.
